title: The R-U-A-Robot Dataset: Helping Avoid Chatbot Deception by Detecting User Questions About Human or Non-Human Identity
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. The benchmark, R-U-A-Robot Dataset, is designed to detect user questions about a system's human or non-human identity.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
